yamlCheck.dateAnchor: No month/day/year is spoken. April 7–12, 1748 comes from YAML; April 7 is only a conditional opening anchor.
yamlCheck.explanation: Four clear overnight transitions are supported. The “next day” ride after the recovery morning (t18) may compress an additional day, but does not unambiguously establish it. The final morning is therefore conditionally April 11 or April 12 from the YAML start. The 03:00 / just-past-midnight discrepancy affects the ambush clock, not the count of nights. Background journeys, forecasts, and historical events do not extend this span.

boundaryUncertainties.reading: The last morning follows the final quiet camp; its absolute date depends on the compressed post-ambush travel transition.

alternatives.reading: If “next day” resumes the recovered morning’s ride, four transitions from the YAML opening reach April 11.
If it advances past that morning to another riding day, five transitions reach April 12.
